metadata.repo_type_justification: Application source code (Python 3.12) with Lambda handler entry points present alongside resource-provisioning IaC (SAM template defining DynamoDB, Lambda, API Gateway, S3). Single-service deployment with OpenAPI contract.
metadata.archetype_justification: DynamoDB writes (create charge, create refund) with idempotency-keyed state management. CRUD endpoints with entity lifecycle. User-specific data via client_id.

classification_consistency_check.reason: Score 3.19 yields Partial band (equivalent to Pilot-Ready) but 2 High findings (OPS-Q5, OPS-Q6) force Remediation Required tier. The service is mature across INF/APP/DATA/SEC but has significant Operations gaps. The count-based tier is authoritative.

top_gaps.title: Deployment Strategy
top_gaps.gap: No staged deployment — no canary, blue/green, or traffic shifting configured
top_gaps.impact: Releases go direct-to-production with no rollback safety net

top_gaps.title: Integration Testing
top_gaps.gap: No integration tests — only unit/contract tests exist
top_gaps.impact: Cannot validate end-to-end behavior before deployment

top_gaps.title: CI/CD Automation
top_gaps.gap: CI pipeline has no deploy stage — deployments are manual
top_gaps.impact: Manual deployments create bottlenecks and inconsistency

top_gaps.title: Anomaly Detection and Alerting
top_gaps.gap: No CloudWatch alarms or anomaly detection configured
top_gaps.impact: Failures and latency regressions go undetected

top_gaps.title: Resource Tagging Governance
top_gaps.gap: No tags on any AWS resources
top_gaps.impact: Cannot track costs or identify ownership

findings.title: Workflow Orchestration — in-code patterns only
findings.description: The service implements a structured idempotent-put pattern in app.py that performs conditional get-put-put within a single Lambda invocation. No external workflow orchestration service (Step Functions, Temporal) is used.
findings.gap: No dedicated workflow orchestration service. If operations grow more complex (multi-step settlements, retries), the in-code approach will not scale.
findings.recommendation: Monitor for increasing complexity. Adopt AWS Step Functions if multi-step operations emerge (charge-settle-notify).

findings.title: Async Messaging — no event emission for state changes
findings.description: The service operates synchronously (API Gateway-Lambda-DynamoDB). No messaging infrastructure (SQS, SNS, EventBridge) is configured. Synchronous pattern is correct for the primary payments request path.
findings.gap: No event publication for payment state changes. Downstream services cannot subscribe to charge.created or refund.created events.
findings.recommendation: Add EventBridge event emission on successful charge creation and refund to enable downstream async consumption.

findings.title: Network Security — no VPC endpoints or PrivateLink
findings.description: API Gateway enforces TLS 1.2+. S3 bucket denies non-TLS requests. Lambda uses AWS-managed networking. No VPC endpoints, PrivateLink, or VPC Lattice configured.
findings.gap: No managed networking services layered on. Lambda-to-DynamoDB traffic traverses AWS backbone without VPC endpoint.
findings.recommendation: Consider placing Lambda in a VPC with DynamoDB VPC endpoint for defense-in-depth if regulated payment data requires network-level isolation.

findings.title: Backup and Recovery — no cross-region replication or restore testing
findings.description: DynamoDB PITR enabled. S3 versioning enabled. No cross-region backup replication. No documented restore procedures. No AWS Backup plan.
findings.gap: Missing cross-region backup replication and documented restore procedures.
findings.recommendation: Add AWS Backup plan resource. Consider DynamoDB cross-region backup for DR. Document and test restore procedures.

findings.title: IaC Coverage — operational resources not codified
findings.description: SAM template defines compute, database, API, and storage. Missing from IaC: CloudWatch alarms, dashboards, backup plans. Approximately 70-80% IaC coverage.
findings.gap: Operational resources (alarms, dashboards, backup plans) are not in IaC.
findings.recommendation: Add CloudWatch alarms, dashboard, and AWS Backup plan resources to the SAM template. Target 90%+ IaC coverage.

findings.title: CI/CD Automation — no deploy stage
findings.description: GitHub Actions CI pipeline automates lint, type-check, OpenAPI validation, and pytest. No deploy stage exists — no sam deploy, no CodePipeline, no automated infrastructure deployment.
findings.gap: Build and test are automated but deployment is entirely manual.
findings.recommendation: Add deploy job to GitHub Actions using sam deploy with environment gates (staging-production). Consider CodePipeline for cross-account deployments.

findings.title: Async vs Sync — synchronous only, no event propagation
findings.description: All communication is synchronous request-response. For a stateful-crud payments service, the synchronous primary path is correct. No outbound service calls. No async event emission for downstream consumers.
findings.gap: No asynchronous state-change propagation for downstream services.
findings.recommendation: Add EventBridge event emission after successful state changes. The synchronous API response path should remain unchanged.

findings.title: Service Discovery — DNS-based only, no dynamic discovery
findings.description: Service discoverable via custom domain backed by API Gateway. No dynamic service discovery (Cloud Map, service mesh). Relies on DNS plus SAM parameters.
findings.gap: No dynamic service discovery mechanism. If outbound service calls are added, hard-coded endpoints would emerge.
findings.recommendation: Current DNS-based discovery is appropriate. If outbound calls are added, adopt Cloud Map or SSM Parameter Store for endpoint resolution.

findings.title: Unstructured Data — S3 storage without parsing pipeline
findings.description: S3 bucket (ReceiptsBucket) for settlement receipts with KMS encryption, TLS enforcement, versioning. No automated parsing or extraction pipeline.
findings.gap: No automated parsing pipeline for receipt documents in S3.
findings.recommendation: If receipt analysis is needed, add Textract or Lambda trigger on S3 PutObject to extract and index receipt content.

findings.title: Compute Hardening — no proactive vulnerability scanning
findings.description: Lambda managed runtime handles OS patching. Dependabot configured for weekly dependency updates. No active vulnerability scanning (Inspector, Snyk, Bandit) in CI.
findings.gap: No proactive vulnerability scanning beyond Dependabot's reactive CVE detection.
findings.recommendation: Add pip-audit or Snyk to CI pipeline. Consider AWS Inspector for Lambda runtime assessment.

findings.title: Security Pipeline — dependency scanning only, no SAST
findings.description: Dependabot configured for dependency scanning. CI runs ruff and mypy but no SAST tool. No security gate blocking on critical findings.
findings.gap: No SAST tool covering application code vulnerabilities.
findings.recommendation: Add Bandit or Semgrep to CI pipeline as a required check blocking on high-severity findings.

findings.title: SLO Definitions — none defined
findings.description: No SLO definitions. No CloudWatch alarms on latency or error rate. No error budget tracking. No alarm resources in SAM template.
findings.gap: No formal SLOs for this payment-critical service.
findings.recommendation: Define SLOs: availability 99.95%, latency p99 < 500ms. Implement CloudWatch alarms. Track error budgets.

findings.title: Business Metrics — partial coverage
findings.description: ChargeCreated metric published via Lambda Powertools. Structured logging with business context. Not systematic across all features (no RefundCreated, no amount metrics, no dashboard).
findings.gap: Business metrics not systematic. Missing RefundCreated, amount metrics, dashboard.
findings.recommendation: Add metrics for all business events. Create CloudWatch dashboard with business and infrastructure metrics.

findings.title: Anomaly Detection and Alerting — none configured
findings.description: No CloudWatch alarms. No anomaly detection. No alerting on error rates or latency. No notification integration.
findings.gap: Complete absence of alerting for a payment-critical service.
findings.recommendation: Add CloudWatch alarms for Lambda errors, duration p99, DynamoDB throttles, API Gateway 5xx. Enable anomaly detection on error rates. Configure SNS notifications.

findings.title: Deployment Strategy — direct-to-production, no staged rollout
findings.description: No deployment strategy configured. No Lambda traffic shifting. No CodeDeploy. No canary or blue/green. CI has no deploy stage. Releases go direct-to-production.
findings.gap: Direct-to-production deployment with no staged rollout or automatic rollback.
findings.recommendation: Add AutoPublishAlias and DeploymentPreference (Canary10Percent5Minutes) to Lambda functions with CloudWatch alarm-triggered rollback.

findings.title: Integration Testing — unit tests only
findings.description: Only unit/contract tests exist (test_idempotency.py, 3 tests). Uses ledger_stub fixture. No integration tests against DynamoDB Local or live endpoints. No API contract tests.
findings.gap: No integration tests validating full Lambda-DynamoDB path or API Gateway configuration.
findings.recommendation: Add integration tests using DynamoDB Local or moto. Add API contract tests validating responses against OpenAPI spec. Run before deploy.

findings.title: Incident Response — no runbooks or automation
findings.description: No runbooks in repository. No SSM Automation documents. No self-healing patterns. External runbook URL referenced but no content in repo.
findings.gap: Complete absence of incident response automation.
findings.recommendation: Create SSM Automation documents for common incidents (throttling, timeout spikes, elevated 5xx). Start with markdown runbooks documenting investigation steps.

findings.title: Observability Ownership — no dashboards or alarm ownership
findings.description: Logging, tracing, and metrics instrumented but no dashboards defined in IaC. No alarm ownership. No CODEOWNERS. Powertools service name provides implicit ownership.
findings.gap: Observability exists but lacks formal ownership structure and dashboards.
findings.recommendation: Add CloudWatch dashboard to SAM template. Add CODEOWNERS file. Tag monitoring resources with team ownership.

findings.title: Resource Tagging — no tags on any resources
findings.description: No tags on any AWS resources in the SAM template. No Tags property on Lambda, DynamoDB, S3, or API Gateway. No tagging standard.
findings.recommendation: Add Tags to SAM Globals or each resource: Environment, Service, Team, CostCenter.

evaluations.title: Managed Compute
evaluations.reason: All compute on Lambda (serverless, ARM64). No EC2.

evaluations.title: Managed Databases
evaluations.reason: DynamoDB fully managed with PAY_PER_REQUEST, PITR, SSE.

evaluations.title: API Entry Point
evaluations.reason: API Gateway with OAuth2 authorizer, custom domain, TLS 1.2, OpenAPI validation.

evaluations.title: High Availability and Fault Isolation
evaluations.reason: Lambda, DynamoDB, API Gateway all inherently multi-AZ.

evaluations.title: Programming Languages
evaluations.reason: Python 3.12 with boto3 and aws-lambda-powertools — modern cloud-native stack.

evaluations.title: Monolith vs Microservices
evaluations.reason: Single-responsibility microservice with clear API contract and own database.

evaluations.title: Long-Running Process Handling
evaluations.reason: All operations are fast DynamoDB reads/writes well under 15s Lambda timeout.

evaluations.title: API Versioning Strategy
evaluations.reason: Consistent /v1/ URL path versioning with OpenAPI spec version tracking.

evaluations.title: Unified Data Access Layer
evaluations.reason: All access through single DynamoDB table via centralized _table object in app.py.

evaluations.title: Database Engine Version and EOL
evaluations.reason: DynamoDB is serverless — no engine version to manage, not subject to EOL.

evaluations.title: Stored Procedures and Schema Complexity
evaluations.reason: No stored procedures or proprietary SQL. DynamoDB NoSQL with all logic in application layer.

evaluations.title: Audit Logging
evaluations.reason: Application-level IaC only (Lambda, DynamoDB, S3, API Gateway). CloudTrail is an account-level concern belonging in foundation infrastructure repo.

evaluations.title: Encryption at Rest
evaluations.reason: DynamoDB SSE enabled. S3 KMS encryption with BucketKeyEnabled.

evaluations.title: API Authentication
evaluations.reason: OAuth2 Lambda authorizer on all endpoints with scope-based authorization.

evaluations.title: Centralized Identity Integration
evaluations.reason: Cognito integration for OAuth2 client-credentials M2M authentication.

evaluations.title: Secrets Management
evaluations.reason: No hardcoded credentials. Environment variables contain only non-secret configuration.

evaluations.title: Distributed Tracing
evaluations.reason: X-Ray tracing with Powertools Tracer and X-Correlation-Id propagation.
